title: Restaurant
subtitle: Ordering a meal and settling the bill
description: You have sat down at a small restaurant. Work through ordering, asking the price, and paying — one sign at a time.
_draftNote: DRAFT conversational order — pending validation by an SSL teacher (School for the Deaf, Ratmalana). The turn order is authored by the development team, not by a signer. The English meanings used here (KANAWA=eat, BONAWA=drink, BILPATHA=bill, MILADII GANNAWA=buy) were confirmed by a native Sinhala speaker in Aug 2026. Each turn asks for exactly ONE gloss; the surrounding text is English context describing intent, never a claim about SSL word order.

turns.partnerLine: A server comes over with a menu and waits for your order.
turns.prompt: Tell them you would like something to eat.
turns.hint: Keep the movement towards your mouth clear and unhurried.

turns.partnerLine: They note it down, then look up again — anything else?
turns.prompt: Now ask for something to drink.
turns.hint: This one is close to the previous sign — make the difference obvious.

turns.partnerLine: They tell you what it costs and check that you have understood.
turns.prompt: Confirm the amount back to them.
turns.hint: Number signs are held briefly — do not rush out of the shape.

turns.prompt: Tell them you will take it.
turns.hint: Finish the full movement before dropping your hands.

turns.partnerLine: You have finished your meal and are ready to leave.
turns.hint: Keep both hands inside the camera frame throughout.
